description: This header file defines utility functions and macros for LAN management, including MAC address derivations from IPv6 addresses and parameter change notifications within the CCSP (Cisco Common Service Platform) framework.

methods.name: LanManager_ParamValueChanged
methods.description: Handles parameter value change notifications within the LAN manager utility.

methods.name: LanManager_GetMACAddrFromIPv6Addr
methods.description: Derives a MAC address from a given IPv6 address according to RFC4291 Appendix A.

methods.name: LanManager_GetMACAddrFromIPv6LinkLocalAddr
methods.description: Derives a MAC address from a link-local IPv6 address; returns NULL if the address is not link-local.

methods.name: LanManager_CheckCloneCopy
methods.description: Copies a string from source to destination, handling allocation and cloning as necessary.
